TRANSFORMATION 1 — what filling missing months does to between-class spectral differences. Both columns are computed on the SAME pixels, so the difference is the imputation and nothing else. Gaps were filled with a global per-calendar-month mean (04_data_prep cell 9), which carries no pixel-specific information. Class ordering agreement Spearman 0.9758; between-class spread of the loss goes from 0.1372 (observed) to 0.1240 (imputed), and the standard deviation of the class means from 0.0512 to 0.0458 — a compression of 10.6%.
